name: DBT Research Associateship (DBT-RA)
funder: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India
amount: Fellowship per DBT norms (not stated in the 2026 call summary; confirm on the call notice)
other_rules: PhD in science/engineering or MD/MS with research interest in biotechnology or life sciences (thesis-submitted candidates may apply)
age limit 40 for men and 45 for women
cannot work with PhD/MD/MS supervisor or at the institution where that degree was earned
employed candidates must resign if selected
notes: 2026 call ran 13 Apr to 12 May 2026; next call expected around the same time. Initial 2 years, extendable to 4 years in exceptional cases. Mentor consent letter and referee letters uploaded on the portal. Details from a Biotecnika summary of the official call (fellowships.gov.in/documents/DBT_RA_CALL_MARCH_2026.pdf); confirm amount and dates there.

documents.name: Recommendation letters
documents.notes: Uploaded by referees on the portal before the deadline
